description: Governor's Secretariat - Central Province - Appointments Made Governor's of the Central Province Chairman and Members of the Authority for Three Years with Effect from 04.01.2023
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple appointments of named individuals (Mr. T. G. Jayatissa, Mr. L. P. G. Saliya Senasekara, etc.) to specific positions (Chairman, Member) in various provincial authorities. It provides only the individuals' names and their basic titles/positions (e.g., "Chairman, Co-operative Service Commission"), without detailing their specific portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) which covers government personnel changes with basic titles only.
